servinfo.title: Fuel Injector Carbon Deposit Inspection

attention3.ptxt: If injector cleaning is not performed periodically as specified in “Scheduled Maintenance”, fuel injectors could become inoperative affected by carbon deposits.

servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the injector inspection, observe Precautions for Fuel System Service:K14C .

s1.ptxt: Set ignition “OFF” and connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC (1).
Start engine and warm it up to normal operating temperature.
Select “Data List” mode on SUZUKI scan tool.
While idling, check “Long Term Fuel Trim” under “Data List”.

ptxt.emph: “Long Term Fuel Trim” standard: less than 23%

s1.ptxt: If “Long Term Fuel Trim” exceeds the limit, perform “Fuel Injector Cleaning”.
After performing “Fuel Injector Cleaning”, check “Long Term Fuel Trim” again and, if the measured value still exceeds the limit, replace all fuel injectors.
